caption:
Toto rides 100 km every weekend, and afterwards her little finger tingles and feels fuzzy.

Leaning on the handlebars for a long time can compress nerves that run through the palm. It often settles once that pressure is reduced.

Hybi's tips: change hand position every 10–15 minutes, keep wrists fairly straight and elbows soft, and wear padded gloves. If it keeps happening, have your bike fit checked.

Numbness lasting for days, a weak or clumsy hand, or neck pain alongside it are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🚴
